instruction.name: movfr2cf
instruction.description: Move the low bit of fj into condition code cd.

latencies.notes: 1 cycle for this direction. The split between the two directions is not observable on this core: every closed chain crosses the boundary both ways, so only the sum shows up (the round trip measures 2.00 cycles and stays additive). The split is fixed by the microarchitecture: an FPR load cannot take the address-bypass path, so `fld.d $f0, $r4, 0; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0` (6.98 cycles) has to be a 5-cycle load plus a 2-cycle move, and the 2.00-cycle FPR round trip then puts the other direction at 1. The stored experiment is the round trip itself, with the opposite direction subtracted as chain_latency.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movfr2cf $fcc0, $f0; movfr2cf $fcc1, $f1; movfr2cf $fcc2, $f2; movfr2cf $fcc3, $f3; movfr2cf $fcc4, $f4; movfr2cf $fcc5, $f5; movfr2cf $fcc6, $f6; movfr2cf $fcc7, $f7

notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1. Throughput is 1 CPI for movcf2gr/movgr2cf and 0.5 CPI for movcf2fr/movfr2cf.
